source.title: Executive Order No. 1395 of 2007 on the electronic Lovtidende, § 1(2): Civilstyrelsen publishes the official gazettes Lovtidende and Ministerialtidende on lovtidende.dk
Executive Order No. 1267 of 2025, § 2: the listed kinds of application to the Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI) go through its digital service on www.nyidanmark.dk
Executive Order No. 1395 of 2007 on the electronic Lovtidende, § 1(3): Civilstyrelsen runs the shared system for rules published on lovtidende.dk and retsinformation.dk
